q: What are the emissions of a paper mill that de-inks waste paper?
title: De-inking paper mill emissions
short: A recycled paper mill pulps waste paper, removes ink by flotation and dries the sheet on steam cylinders. Steam for drying and electricity for pulping are the main sources. De-inking sludge going to landfill or boilers adds a waste line.
audience: Recycled paper mills and packaging buyers

ul: Electricity for pulpers, screens and the paper machine.
Sludge disposal, in Category 5 if sent out.

p: If the mill burns rejects or sludge, the fibre carbon is biogenic. Plastic in the rejects is fossil.

senseible: Senseible reads the plant's electricity bills (CEA grid factor 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh, CO2 Baseline Database version 21.0) and fuel invoices (IPCC 2006 defaults) into a fingerprinted Scope 1 and 2 record, the plant-level input to a per-unit figure. Bought-in materials go to the supplier evidence trail; product reports are self-declared drafts.

sources.label: IPCC 2006 Guidelines for National Greenhouse Gas Inventories
